subject: Post-call: qualification & legal routing plan for Caldwell Health
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Caldwell <alex@caldwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Recap & next steps after intro call

Alex — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed path to get Caldwell ready for a pilot: 

Summary of needs
- Use case: clinical summarization for discharge notes (high PII sensitivity)
- Target latency: <=300ms median for short notes, batch nightly for historical backfill
- Key success metrics: extraction accuracy >= 92% F1 on our prompt suite, integration with Epic via SFTP/HL7

Stakeholders you mentioned
- Economic sponsor: Maya Torres (CFO) — final budget sign-off
- Security/compliance: Daniel Ruiz (Head of InfoSec) — SOC2 evidence, data residency constraints
- Procurement: procurement@caldwellhealth.com (owns MSA review)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) We'll send a draft NDA and an outline of the pilot SOW for your legal and procurement review (attached). Please confirm the right NDA contact if not legal@caldwellhealth.com.
2) Ben will outline expected turn-times for redlines and propose a routing sequence (legal -> procurement -> finance).
3) Can you confirm whether Maya wants a 1-pager for budget committee? If yes, we'll create a succinct ROI slide.

Timing proposal
- NDA out today (EOD PT) — target return with comments within 3 business days
- SOW + pilot plan by Friday — goal to start onboarding in January if NDA & SOW accepted

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf (stub), Caldwell_SOW_notes.docx (summary of scope)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Ben on routing/turn-times.

—
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

From: Alex Caldwell <alex@caldwellhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps after intro call

Thanks Priyom — useful recap. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- Confirmed internal owners: Maya Torres (CFO) will be the economic owner. I copied her on this thread separately.
- Security: Daniel Ruiz will lead InfoSec review; prefer to see a DPA + SOC2 artifacts. Daniel will want to know where keys are stored and whether we support customer-managed KMS.
- Procurement routing: procurement@caldwellhealth.com will triage; procurement asks for MSAs to arrive through our DocuSign instance. They expect 5 business days turnaround for initial redlines.

NDA: yes please send. Legal@CaldwellHealth is the right inbox for the NDA. If we can get that signed quickly, I can fast-track the budget committee — they generally need a 1-pager and a rough cost estimate.

I’ll loop Maya and Daniel when the NDA and SOW are in place.

Alex
Director of Clinical Innovation
Caldwell Health
alex@caldwellhealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Caldwell <alex@caldwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps after intro call

Alex — attached is the NDA (Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf). Quick notes on the legal path and proposed SLAs for routing: 

Proposed routing sequence (recommended)
1) Legal (initial review & redline) — target 3 business days for first pass
2) Security (DPA/SOC2 questions + KMS confirmation) — target 3 business days concurrent with legal
3) Procurement (commercial terms & signature) — target 5 business days after legal clears

Turn-times and fallbacks
- We commit to 3 business days for our internal legal to respond to redlines; if procurement requires a longer review, we’ll offer a canary MSA (standard terms) to accelerate pilot start while longer-term terms are negotiated.
- For KMS requests: we support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted evaluation will need SOC2 evidence and an agreed DPA scope.

Action items
- Ben: can you validate our internal SSO/KMS note for Daniel and propose a timeline for Redwood legal to return redlines?
- Alex: please confirm if Legal@CaldwellHealth is the NDA inbox and if Maya wants the 1-pager.

Thanks — sending DocuSign link once legal confirms the final PDF version.

Regards,
Priyom
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: routing & redline cadence for Caldwell pilot

Looping in our playbook for this sort of hospital/health system. Key recommendations for speed: 

1) Submit NDA + short SOW (we already have both attached to the external thread). Turn-times: legal 48–72 hrs internal first pass.
2) Provide Daniel with a short KMS & SOC2 one-pager (I’ll draft) so he can sign off faster; include diagram of data flow and where PHI is stored/processed.
3) If procurement insists on 5 business days, propose a staged signature: pilot SOW + MSA appendix A (limited liability for pilot) to start work; leave enterprise commercial terms under longer negotiation.

I suggest we commit an internal legal owner (me) to shepherd the redlines and a single point of contact for Caldwell procurement. I’ll follow up with an estimated legal response date (likely 2026-12-23 EOD PT).

—
Ben Carter
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Alex Caldwell <alex@caldwellhealth.com>

Thanks team — appreciated. Legal@CaldwellHealth is correct for the NDA. Maya wants the 1-pager; I’ve asked her assistant to add a 15-minute slot next week for a quick budget sync if you can provide the ROI slide by Friday.

Procurement confirms 5 business day initial redline window (we’ll start once NDA is in place). Daniel will expect the SOC2 cert and a KMS diagram; please send both into his inbox (dan.ruiz@caldwellhealth.com).

DocuSign: yes please send the execution-ready NDA via DocuSign and copy procurement. If we can get the pilot SOW in parallel, that would be ideal.

Alex
